content:
Rina Kapoor: Quick thread 1 Customer 'Atlas' wants a low-touch on-prem path: VPC peering + customer-run BGP + preserved egress IPs. Asks for a single-command installer + a tiny operator shim. Can this be a gated beta?
Jared Lee: Sounds reasonable if it's enabling 2+ paying customers. We should define a minimal deliverable: CLI installer, preflight checks, egress-claim flow, and a documented fallback to hosted inference.
Marta Iverson: Delivery split idea: Phase A (installer + shim + preflight) as beta; Phase B (full bundle w/ in-place upgrades + automated patching) stable release. Phase A = spike + 2-week beta cycle.
Noor Patel: Installer UX proposal: `redwood install --mode=byo --egress-prefix=203.0.113.8/29 --preserve-egress --dry-run` -> run validations, report conflicts, require `--confirm`. Emit audit event `egress.claim` on success.
Sam O'Connor: Test plan: internal canary (2 tenants), 48h soak, simulate BGP flap, ensure fallback to hosted for 5-15m, validate token backfill and KMS rotation during upgrade window. Target: <3h maintenance for customers.
Jared Lee: Launch gates (draft): 1) Field sign-off from at least one paying customer; 2) Installer preflight + `--dry-run` output; 3) Migration dry-run with rollback tested; 4) Runbook & ops checklist; 5) Beta support tagging + billing label; 6) Console toggle for fallback policy.
Marta Iverson: Risks: overlapping private CIDRs -> SNAT requirement -> may break upstream ACLs. Need clear tradeoff doc and an explicit `--snat=preserve|force` flag. Also document failure modes for partial peering.
InfraBot: CI report: branch feat/byo-shim -> installer smoke 6/6 passed, BGP sim tests failing intermittently (investigating).
Noor Patel: UX edge case: if user omits `--egress-prefix`, installer should refuse and recommend public egress or provide guidance to obtain IPs. Add warning in docs.
Sam O'Connor: Action items: Noor/Jared/Marta to produce a 1-page launch checklist + migration playbook by EOD Wed. I'll set up a 30m runbook review with FieldOps next Fri.
Rina Kapoor: Thanks all  we'll slot this into roadmap planning and mark as beta-by-request. :rocket:
